title: President's Doctoral Scholarship
institution: The University of Manchester, Faculty of Science and Engineering
about: The University of Manchester's Faculty of Science and Engineering invites applications to the President's Doctoral Scholarship for 2027 entry. Projects were announced on 30 October 2026; applicants contact the project supervisor and apply for a PhD programme. The application deadline is 18 December 2026.
requirements: Applicants must contact the supervisor of the project they are interested in
Applicants must have submitted an application for a PhD programme by the published deadline

upskill.name: AI for Research & Academic Productivity
why: field "Science and engineering doctoral research" -> objective "Use AI to support literature exploration, academic reading, information organization, research planning, and knowledge synthesis."

requirement "contact the supervisor of the project they are interested in" (project-based doctoral research) -> objective "Summarize and compare scholarly materials while identifying recurring themes, methodological differences, arguments, findings, limitations, and potential research gaps."
